mono_numeric.notes: Exact TMP font asset/prefab size needs a runtime prefab dump; role mapping inferred from font names + TMP SDF atlas assets.

substitution_rules: Prefer the TMP SDF atlas texture ('Roboto-Regular SDF Atlas', 'Roboto-Bold SDF Atlas') for text at the game's TMP look; render SDF glyph quads/distance-field text if the backend supports it.

Fallback: load the extracted TTFs (Roboto-Regular.ttf / Roboto-Bold.ttf, LiberationSans.ttf for Latin fallback) and render at logical sizes scaled by the UIScaler factor min(h/1080, w/1920) * uiScale.

Reference sizes at 1080p (inferred from TMP font assets/prefab conventions): body 16 px, heading/bold 20 px, small labels 14 px, monospace counters 16 px. Exact prefab sizes need the runtime prefab dump.
Numerical/time/node-value displays may use the monospace family (Inconsolata-SemiBold / PerfectDOSVGA437 / CONSOLA); validate against screenshots before locking the role.
If an atlas texture is unusable, fall back to the TTF with a slight letter-spacing/scale compensation and note the visual delta in the screenshot-diff report.

phase_p0.notes: Load sprites + border/pivot from ui_atlas.json; tint via default_tint. Shared chrome is intentional (many panels reuse UISprite/gray_panel/Long_UI).
Use fonts.roles: body/bold/mono_numeric; UIScaler factor min(h/1080,w/1920)*uiScale; reference sizes in fonts.substitution_rules.
Status bar fills tint from health/energy ratio. Speed slider reuses slider widgets.
phase_p0.step: HUD: time panel, playback icons, status bars

phase_p0.notes: Build as shared immediate-mode widgets; 9-slice borders from atlas (inferred ones flagged needs_prefab).
phase_p0.step: Core widgets: buttons, toggles, sliders, dropdowns, progress, inputs

phase_p0.notes: Selection rect is a tinted 1px border; highlight uses ui/material/selection_highlight_material.
Use flat rows/labels composed from widgets; exact prefab rects still need the runtime dump (needs_prefab list).

phase_p0b.notes: Organ schematic uses internals_preview/internalssections materials; stomach contents use procedural pellet sprites.
Use brain_icons.inputs/outputs/activations index→filename tables exactly; node/synapse colouring uses materials.
phase_p0b.step: Brain simple panel + brain icon tables

phase_p0b.notes: Pie segments may be generated meshes (chart_ring_segment kind); colour-killer uses rainbowMaterial + tolerance shader.
phase_p0b.step: Statistics panel (wedges/pies) + multi-selection + escape + tool panels

phase_p0b.notes: Reuse shared chrome; blocking/pause-source stack is UI-state work, not asset work.

phase_p1.notes: Graph series come from the viewer-side 60s sampler; line renders may use LineRenderer-like primitives instead of sprites.
FOV target indicator is runtime-procedural (bibite/pellet/egg sprites); FOV cone is a shader material.
